load_trec_eval_metric: load the trec_eval metric from the Hugging Face evaluate library
launch_gradio_widget: launch a gradio widget for the trec_eval metric
evaluate_predictions: evaluate predictions using the trec_eval metric with ground truth and predicted labels
compute_trec_metrics: compute trec evaluation metrics such as precision, recall, and F1 for information retrieval
run_gradio_interface: run a gradio interface to interactively test the trec_eval metric
